# Getting help

Start with [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md) for the four rules, workflows, and reference index, and the [agent commit protocol](../references/agent-commit-protocol.md) for the full contract. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for making changes.

Search [existing issues](https://github.com/YourAKShaw/conventional-commits-framework/issues) before opening a report. Use the bug, improvement, or documentation form when one fits. For a usage question, open a blank issue with the commit message involved, what you expected, the checker or commitlint output, and your agent host, model, and Python or Node.js version where relevant.

Share only sanitized examples. Do not post credentials, private source code, or internal ticket details in public issues. Agent hosts sometimes add their own attribution or commit behavior; include enough context to distinguish that from this skill's guidance, and report host problems to the host's provider.
